10th Level

  • When you critically hit a creature, its resistances are halved against all damage until the end of your next turn.
  • When you critically hit a creature or object, you may attempt to counteract one magical effect on it, once per round.
    • Your counteract rank is half your level rounded up, and your counteract check is your attack roll modifier with the weapon you used.

Granted automatically by Ruinous Blows at 10th level.
